recommendations: Use a single oral antiplatelet agent (preferably clopidogrel) for up to 12 months for stroke prevention in the described context.
During PCI, give an unfractionated heparin (UFH) bolus in either of the following circumstances: patient is on a NOAC; INR is <2.5 in VKA-treated patients.
content.not_recommended: use of ticagrelor or prasugrel as part of triple antithrombotic therapy
